name: General enquiry
summary: Greetings, unclear requests, and anything outside the supported ticket types.

steps.title: Clarify
steps.instruction: Ask a short clarifying question to find out what the patient needs.

steps.title: Out of scope
steps.instruction: If the request is outside what you can do (e.g. address change, technical issue, complaint), escalate_to_support with a summary and tell the patient a team member will follow up.
